scope: One bounded P5/R12 recursive-improvement discovery experiment on unchanged Harness implementation source. The Agent consumed one mechanical repository map plus exact independent Host/World failure evidence, selected all subsequent repository observations itself, reduced admitted observations from the P4 baseline of 203 to 8 while performing six real source/reference investigations, and lawfully abstained because it could not prove a reachable causal source defect. This validates evidence-driven observation selection and compact Working-View mechanics, not defect-freedom, token-efficient autonomous discovery, or a fix for the separate no-Tool conclusion-correction failure.

negativeControl.interpretation: Minimizing observation count alone rewards ignorance: the Agent saw only the repository map and abstained despite independently existing external failure evidence. P5 therefore changed its objective from fewest observations to highest decision value per observation.

externalWorldEvidence.observedFailure: World HP4 reported one structured-result no-Tool Harness Run entering correction/control handling and failing with ToolBridgeError: no-Tool Agent Run cannot bind Tool observations or Tool Call identities; other independent Runs succeeded.

initialModelViewPreflight.result: full repository index plus duplicated recent exact data exceeded the default model-observation boundary before Provider dispatch
initialModelViewPreflight.repair: retain one durable full index while preventing duplicate exact projection; do not classify as repository evidence

tokenPreflight.result: conservative request upper bound exceeded the first experimental token envelope before dispatch
tokenPreflight.repair: set a bounded experiment envelope large enough for the mechanical map while continuing to measure actual Provider usage independently

largeActionEncoding.result: DeepSeek submit_run_conclusion function arguments were invalid JSON under the large nested decision schema.
largeActionEncoding.repair: use a thin Harness structured envelope with one decisionJson string, then strictly decode and admit the semantic decision caller-side; validation was moved, not weakened.

failedActionProjection.result: Agent requested nonexistent or contract-invalid discovery actions during localization.
failedActionProjection.repair: retain exact rejected actions in durable experiment checkpoints while projecting only capability, decision digest and abstract failure class into the next Working View; failed action bytes are not replayed.

workingViewCompaction.law: Full exact repository/index history may remain durable while the model-visible Working View carries a compact addressability map plus only the current exact observation needed for the next decision.

checkpointRecovery.result: A successful observation could be lost from the experiment partial checkpoint if the following model round failed preflight.
checkpointRecovery.repair: persist the partial checkpoint again immediately after each admitted observation; rejected actions are also checkpointed and resumable.

acceptedDiscovery.finalBoundary: The Agent verified a deliberate no-Tool guard in SQLiteHarnessAgentBridge and adjacent source/reference evidence, but did not prove any real invocation path with non-empty observations/seen_tool_call_ids, any failing unittest, or any reproducible causal baseline defect. It therefore abstained rather than converting correlation into source authority.

acceptedTrajectoryProviderCost.interpretation: P5 improves observation traversal and decision relevance, not token/model-call efficiency. Reconstructing a large fresh one-decision Working View twelve times remains expensive.

checks: only experiment runner untracked before cleanup

authorityOutcome.reason: No causal baseline-red target was established. Exercising mutation/promotion authorities would fabricate work and violate the P4/P5 admission law.

remainingBoundaries: P5 is a bounded R12 evidence-driven high-information discovery instance, not autonomous indefinite recursive self-improvement.
The separate no-Tool conclusion-correction Host task remains unresolved; P5 did not prove or fix its source cause.
Observation count fell 25.375x versus P4, but the accepted trajectory still consumed 12 Provider calls and 239,953 total tokens; token/computation efficiency remains open.
The discovery runner, repository map projection and decisionJson envelope are experiment scaffolding, not supported Harness APIs.
A future independently causal target is still required before P5-style discovery can re-exercise generator/materializer/evaluator/promotion branches under this more efficient observation ownership.
No Scheduler, Goal Stream, generic Evaluator Service, Memory/RAG subsystem, DAG, RSI Controller or second persistence layer was forced.
